ruleDefinitions.name: Download File To Potentially Suspicious Directory Via Wget
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of wget to download content to a suspicious directory

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/wget$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\s-O\s") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-output\\-document.*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/tmp\\/.*"))
